customers.evidence: We believe our first responsibility is to the patients, doctors and nurses, to mothers and fathers and all others who use our products and services.

employees.evidence: We must provide an inclusive work environment where each person must be considered as an individual.

dei.evidence: We must respect their diversity and dignity and recognize their merit.

environment.evidence: protecting the environment and natural resources

community.evidence: We must help people be healthier by supporting better access and care in more places around the world.

shareholders.evidence: Our final responsibility is to our stockholders.

integrity.evidence: We must provide highly capable leaders and their actions must be just and ethical.

safety.evidence: Compensation must be fair and adequate and working conditions clean, orderly and safe.

innovation.evidence: Research must be carried on, innovative programs developed, investments made for the future and mistakes paid for.

result.analyst_notes: Credo-style text in first-person plural with absolute directives (must, must not). Responsibilities are ordered: patients and customers first, then employees, communities, and stockholders last. Tone is aspirational and moral rather than factual, with few hedges. Stakeholder language is broad and principled, and it names no metrics or targets.
